facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.prepare_graph_convolution_input: prepare an adjacency matrix for graph convolution layers by symmetrically normalizing it with numpy

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.get_adjacency_matrix: compute the adjacency matrix for the Diplomacy map showing which locations are adjacent to each other
